extraction.Name: Nellie Larvie Brown
extraction.Refused/Protested: I did not want this patent but it was sent to me without my asking for it.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I could not pay the taxes
extraction.Occupation/Income: My husband and I support three and the others take care of themselves
extraction.NOTES: Not in good health; has six children; was not satisfied with the sale, stating 'that Tx was not enough for it'; received $4800.00 for the land; does not remember signing a receipt for it; did not ask for the patent; patent was mailed to her in 1918; notarized by Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, on June 4, 1929
